mapper.select: SELECT r.y AS RECENT_YEAR , r.m AS RECENT_MONTH , r.total_kwh AS RECENT_TOTAL_KWH , r.avg_kwh AS RECENT_AVG_KWH , f.y AS FORECAST_YEAR , f.m AS FORECAST_MONTH , f.total_kwh AS PREDICTED_TOTAL_KWH , f.avg_kwh AS PREDICTED_AVG_KWH , ROUND((f.total_kwh / f.prev_total_kwh - 1) * 100, 1) AS YOY_PCT , ROUND(b.mape, 2) AS MAPE FROM (SELECT md.year AS y, md.month AS m , SUM(md.usage_kwh) AS total_kwh , AVG(md.usage_kwh) AS avg_kwh FROM monthly_data md JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = md.region_id WHERE rg.region_name = #{regionName} GROUP BY md.year, md.month ORDER BY md.year DESC, md.month DESC LIMIT 1) r , (SELECT fc.year AS y, fc.month AS m , SUM(fc.predicted_kwh) AS total_kwh , AVG(fc.predicted_kwh) AS avg_kwh , SUM(fc.prev_year_kwh) AS prev_total_kwh FROM forecast fc JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = fc.region_id WHERE rg.region_name = #{regionName} GROUP BY fc.year, fc.month ORDER BY fc.year, fc.month LIMIT 1) f , (SELECT AVG(ABS(bt.predicted_kwh - bt.actual_kwh) / bt.actual_kwh) * 100 AS mape FROM backtest bt JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = bt.region_id WHERE rg.region_name = #{regionName} ) b

SELECT md.year AS DATA_YEAR , md.month AS DATA_MONTH , SUM(md.usage_kwh) AS TOTAL_KWH , AVG(md.usage_kwh) AS AVG_KWH FROM monthly_data md JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = md.region_id WHERE rg.region_name = #{regionName} GROUP BY md.year, md.month ORDER BY md.year, md.month

SELECT fc.year AS DATA_YEAR , fc.month AS DATA_MONTH , SUM(fc.predicted_kwh) AS TOTAL_KWH , AVG(fc.predicted_kwh) AS AVG_KWH , SUM(fc.prev_year_kwh) AS PREV_TOTAL_KWH , AVG(fc.prev_year_kwh) AS PREV_AVG_KWH , ROUND((SUM(fc.predicted_kwh) / SUM(fc.prev_year_kwh) - 1) * 100, 1) AS YOY_PCT FROM forecast fc JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = fc.region_id WHERE rg.region_name = #{regionName} GROUP BY fc.year, fc.month ORDER BY fc.year, fc.month

SELECT rg.short_name AS SHORT_NAME , rg.region_name AS REGION_NAME , fc.year AS DATA_YEAR , fc.month AS DATA_MONTH , ROUND((fc.predicted_kwh / fc.prev_year_kwh - 1) * 100, 1) AS YOY_PCT FROM forecast fc JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = fc.region_id JOIN (SELECT year AS y, month AS m FROM forecast ORDER BY year, month LIMIT 1) t ON fc.year = t.y AND fc.month = t.m ORDER BY YOY_PCT DESC, rg.short_name
SELECT region_name AS REGION_NAME, short_name AS SHORT_NAME FROM region ORDER BY region_id
